newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Friesland may take over Hajdutej by April.
newsitem.headline: Friesland may take over Hajdutej by April.

text.p: Dutch company Friesland Dairy Foods may take over Nutricia International's 96.7 percent stake in Hungarian dairy firm Hajdutej by April, Sandor Mile, a Hajdutej director, said on Thursday.
The deal would be part of planned international co-operation between the two Dutch food producers, which are negotiating to link or transfer activities.
"I think (the take-over) will be completed by the general meeting of (Hajdutej) shareholders planned for April if the talks are successful," Mile told Reuters.

He said that if Nutricia kept control of Hajdutej, it would probably delist the shares from the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE). But if Friesland took control, Hajdutej might remain listed as this could help the company gain access to cheap funds for development.
Nutricia boosted its stake in Hajdutej to 96.7 percent from 79.6 percent by buying shares from managers and other owners at the end of December, making the stock very illiquid, Mile said.
